image_generation.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium landscape cover illustration for a French-language university Master statistics course PDF. Primary request: diverse Master students in a modern Tunisian university studying separately at their own laptops, with one approachable coach in the background. Elegant flat editorial blue vector-like illustration, crisp sophisticated shapes, expressive but refined students and plausible hands. Composition: wide 3:2 landscape. Scene occupies right two-thirds, with left third and upper-left negative space in dark navy reserved for independently typeset title. Subtle giant circular framing and sparse data dots. Simplified unlabeled bar/scatter marks only on laptop screens. Modern bright campus windows with understated Tunisian Mediterranean ambience. Palette: dark navy #07152F, indigo #2B3180, electric blue #4E73FF, orange #FF9A3C, off-white. Print-ready high resolution with clean edges and polished visual rhythm. No text, no letters, no logos, no numbers, no watermark. Decorative illustration only; not a technical diagram. Avoid generic clipart, gradients with banding, clutter, overly cute cartoon proportions, or color outside the palette.
